meta.title: Beat Broker Crashes on Jio IPO Listing Day
meta.topic: Beat Broker Crashes on Jio IPO Listing Day

scenes.headline: Ye kaise hua? *Jio* IPO listing day par *Broker* crash!
scenes.voice: Arre dosto, kal Jio ka IPO listing tha aur saare brokers ka system ek saath crash ho gaya! Socho aapka order queue mein atka hai aur market rocket ho raha hai.

scenes.headline: Request Pipeline *(Overload)*
scenes.voice: Matlab 10 million concurrent requests ek sath API gateway par hit kiye. Redis cache flush ho gaya aur database connections pool completely exhaust ho gaye.

scenes.headline: Blocking _Database_ Query
scenes.voice: Dekho, problem yahan thi. Yeh sync DB query har user ke portfolio ko fetch karne ki koshish kar rahi thi bina kisi proper indexing ke.

scenes.headline: 500K Orders *(Dropped)*
scenes.voice: Sirf teen minute ke andar paanch lakh se zyada orders drop ho gaye. Latency spike hokar 4200 milliseconds tak pahunch gayi thi!
scenes.label: Performance Metric

scenes.headline: Out of *Memory* Exception
scenes.voice: Terminal logs me saaf dikh raha tha ki Kubernetes pods ek ke baad ek OOM killed ho rahe the kyunki auto-scaler slow tha.

scenes.headline: Kafka Event *Streaming*
scenes.voice: Agar inhone synchronous REST calls ki jagah Apache Kafka event streaming use kiya hota, toh queue manage ho sakti thi bina system crash ke.
scenes.cardSubtitle: Decouple ingestion from execution using topic partitions.

scenes.headline: Aise *System Design* breakdowns ke liye follow karo!
scenes.voice: Aise hi real-world tech disasters aur system design breakdowns ke liye @techwith.GenZ ko abhi follow karo!
